summary_en: Oricon will acquire 125,800 treasury shares at no cost on September 25, 2026, representing 0.83% of outstanding shares, following the termination of executive and employee stock grant trusts ahead of delisting on September 28, 2026. The acquired shares will be cancelled on September 29, 2026, together with 152 fractional shares previously acquired, totaling 125,952 shares for cancellation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Free Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Shares in Connection with Termination of Executive and Employee Stock Grant Trusts
translation_en_brief:
Oricon announced on September 24, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to acquire 125,800 treasury shares at no cost on September 25, 2026, and to cancel these shares on September 29, 2026. The acquisition is from Japan Custody Bank (Trust Account), which serves as trustee of the stock grant trusts. The 125,800 shares represent 0.83% of outstanding shares as of June 30, 2026, based on 15,123,200 total shares issued. Additionally, 152 fractional shares acquired through separate statutory buy-in requests will be cancelled together with the trust-related shares, bringing the total cancellation to 125,952 shares.

The acquisition and cancellation follow the termination of executive and employee stock grant trusts that Oricon had operated since August 2022. The termination is necessitated by the company's delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange, scheduled for September 28, 2026, following a three-week adjustment period beginning September 7, 2026. Under the trust agreements, the termination triggers the return of residual trust assets—the 125,800 shares—to the company for acquisition and subsequent cancellation.

Following this cancellation and a separate cancellation of 2,109,125 shares approved on August 7, 2026 (also effective September 29, 2026), Oricon's total outstanding shares will decrease to 12,888,123 shares.
